policies.name: tenant_read
policies.qual:
(private.can(organization_id, 'intake'::text) OR (private.has_role(organization_id) AND (assigned_to = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM company_modules cm
  WHERE ((cm.organization_id = intake_requests.organization_id) AND (cm.module = 'intake'::text) AND cm.enabled)))))

policies.name: workforce_read
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM time_entries e
  WHERE ((e.organization_id = time_reviews.organization_id) AND (e.id = time_reviews.entry_id) AND private.worker_access(e.organization_id, e.worker_id))))
